mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_fund_log (order_id, user_id, amount, type, status, trade_no, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{status}, #{tradeNo}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_fund_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_fund_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_fund_log WHERE user_id = #{userId}
